name: Francis of Assisi
description: Founder of the Franciscans, born 1181 to a cloth-merchant family, who embraced absolute poverty and preaching; possesses True Faith and supernatural Abilities.

name: Pietro Bernadone
description: Prosperous cloth-merchant father of Francis who paid his ransom after the war with Perugia.

name: Pope Innocent III
description: Pope who, after a prophetic dream of the Lateran Basilica, gave Francis his blessing and allowed Clare's community to remain in poverty.

name: Pope Honorius III
description: Pope who approved the Dominicans in 1216 and supported the Little Brothers; issued the letter Cum Delicti and approved the Regula Bullata in 1223.

name: Dominic
description: Augustinian canon from Spain who founded the Order of Preachers and became its first master general; dies in Italy soon after 1221.

name: Cardinal Ugolino
description: Cardinal appointed protector of Francis' followers who took control of the movement and tried to make the friars and Poor Sisters live more like Benedictines.

name: Sylvester of Assisi
description: Founder member of the Franciscans, a priest and cousin of Clare, who dreamt of a cross from Francis' mouth putting a dragon to flight.

name: Bernard of Quintavalle
description: Founder member of the Franciscans whom player characters may meet.

name: Rufino
description: Early Franciscan follower, a priest and cousin of Clare.

name: Leo
description: Priest among the early Franciscans, known as Brother Lamb of God; Francis' confessor and scribe.

name: Giles of Assisi
description: Early follower of Francis, a farmer's son noted for fervent prayer and mysticism.

name: Masseo
description: Early follower of Francis known for his eloquence and courtesy.

name: Anthony of Padova
description: One of the early followers of Francis.

name: Simon of Assisi
description: One of the early followers of Francis.

name: Christopher of Romagna
description: One of the early followers of Francis.

name: Peter Catanio
description: One of the early followers of Francis.

name: Sabbatinus
description: One of the early followers of Francis.

name: Moricus the Short
description: One of the early followers of Francis.

name: John of Capella
description: Early follower of Francis who, while Francis was away, gathered lepers and began to develop a new religious order for them.

name: Philip the Tall
description: One of the early followers of Francis.

name: John of San Costanzo
description: One of the early followers of Francis.

name: Juniper
description: One of the early followers of Francis.

name: Barbarus
description: One of the early followers of Francis.

name: Bernard Vigilante de Vida
description: One of the early followers of Francis.

name: Angelo Tancredi
description: Early follower of Francis from Rieti, a noble knight before joining.

name: Brother Illuminato
description: Franciscan who accompanied Francis to meet the Sultan of Egypt.

name: Sultan of Egypt
description: Muslim ruler who received Francis courteously in his encampment, offered gifts, and sent him back to the Christian camp.

name: Brother Elias Bonibarone
description: Minister General of the Little Brothers, born 1180 at Belvilia; handles active leadership as Francis' health fails and is tempted by acquiring land and money.

name: Giovanni Parenti
description: Provincial of Spain who historically succeeds Elias at the head of the Franciscans.

name: Clare of Assisi
description: Noblewoman of Assisi, born 1194, who followed Francis, became abbess of the Poor Sisters at Saint Damian, and wrote the first rule by a woman.

name: Favarone di Offreduccio
description: Noble father of Clare of Assisi.

name: Ortolana
description: Mother of Clare of Assisi.

name: Agnes of Assisi
description: Clare's sister, born Catherine, saved by miracle from her family and renamed Agnes; founded a community at Monticelli in 1219.

name: Balvina
description: Clare's niece who moved from Arezzo in 1214 to become abbess of Vallegloria, Spello.

name: Marsebilia
description: Companion of Clare who started a new Poor Sisters group in Foligno in 1217 as its abbess.

name: Cristiana
description: Companion of Clare who co-founded the Foligno community in 1217.

name: Pope Innocent IV
description: Pope to whom Clare's completed written rule is presented in 1253.

name: Pope Gregory IX
description: Pope who in 1228 authorizes the Poor Sisters' way of life with the privilege of poverty.

name: Miramolin
description: King of Morocco who imprisoned and later killed Franciscan friars, whose remains the flames would not touch.

name: Bartholomew
description: Man visited by Francis who had a demon-possessed madman living with him; God silenced the demon.

name: Jean de Brienne
description: Emperor of Constantinople who, after dreams of friars, gave up his throne to live as a friar until his death.

name: Franciscans
description: Religious movement founded by Francis of Assisi living in absolute poverty, begging and preaching; lacks official papal approval in 1220.

name: Poor Sisters
description: Community of women following Francis' ideals under Clare at Saint Damian, living in poverty without total enclosure.

name: Order of Preachers
description: Dominican friars founded by Dominic to preach the gospel and combat heresy, emphasizing learning and university involvement.

name: Carmelites
description: One of the mendicant orders to which friars and nuns belong.

name: Mendicants
description: Religious who own no possessions personally or as a group, may beg, and answer to their own leaders and the pope rather than the local bishop.

name: Tertiaries
description: Laymen following the Franciscan lifestyle without clerical vows, living with their families, under a rule of 1221.

name: Benedictines
description: Long-standing monastic order whose monasteries and rule are challenged by Francis' movement.

name: Albigensians
description: Cathar movement in southern France whose popularity inspired Dominic.

name: Saracens
description: Muslims to whom Francis sought to preach; the Franciscans in Morocco stirred dissent between Christians and Saracens.

name: Sufi
description: Muslim mystic suspected by some of afflicting Francis with illness.

name: Order of Hermes
description: The order of magi; no documented interactions with the Friars Minor yet, though stories circulate.

name: Redcaps
description: Hermetic messengers; one lost an enchanted brooch found by a Franciscan friar.

name: Mystery Cult
description: Secretive initiatory group; outsiders may view the Franciscans as a Mystery Cult or Holy Tradition.

name: House Jerbiton
description: Hermetic House most likely to take an active interest in the Franciscan leadership succession.

name: House Bjornaer
description: Hermetic House whose members might attend Francis' sermons to animals in the wild.

name: Normandy Tribunal
description: Hermetic tribunal where a story circulates of a friar who lived with a spring covenant.

name: Holy Tradition: Franciscans
description: Treatment of the Franciscans as a Holy Tradition with favored Abilities Intervention, Meditation, Purity, and Understanding, open only to friars or Poor Sisters.

name: Holy Tradition
description: Divine initiatory tradition, treated like a Mystery Cult, granting supernatural Abilities.

name: Initiation Script
description: Set of requirements for initiating a Virtue, here modeled on formative experiences in the life of Francis.

name: Mystagogue
description: Initiator who guides and instructs an Initiate through an Initiation Script.

name: Ordeal
description: Initiation component imposing a Flaw or hardship; Major and Minor Ordeals give Script bonuses.

name: Quest
description: Initiation component requiring the Initiate to undertake a task, worth a Script bonus of 3.

name: Path of the Founder
description: Sympathy bonus for Initiation Scripts that imitate the life of Francis.

name: Psychodrama
description: Technique of acting out situations during Initiation, referenced from Houses of Hermes: Mystery Cults.

name: Divine Ascension
description: Experience of Divine Unity from which Francis' supernatural Abilities derive.

name: Divine Warping
description: Warping from the Divine, cause of Francis' Fragile Constitution and future stigmata.

name: Warping
description: Supernatural distortion measured by a Warping Score.

name: Stigmata
description: Wounds of Christ given to Francis by God in 1224, historically.

name: Faith Points
description: Points granted by True Faith that can be used like Confidence.

name: Hope
description: Advantage of True Faith 5 adding 6 when using Faith Points like Confidence.

name: Charity
description: Advantage of True Faith 5 making the bearer radiate a Divine Empyreal aura.

name: Empyreal Aura
description: Tangible Divine aura radiated by Francis at level 1 to Voice range.

name: True Faith Magic Resistance
description: Magic resistance derived from True Faith.

name: Devotion Point
description: Point of devotion to a saint listeners may gain from preaching.

name: Ceremonial Influence
description: Game mechanic by which preachers change Personality Traits.

name: Personality Traits
description: Character traits that preaching can temporarily inculcate.

name: Reputation
description: Measure of a character's renown; preachers depend on it.

name: Exposure Experience
description: Experience points gained from casual attendance at preaching, even in unknown Abilities.

name: Aesthetic Quality
description: Quality of a preacher's performance used as the study source for followers.

name: Preaching
description: Popular preaching outdoors in the vernacular, treated as performance; only ordained priests may preach without Church concern.

name: Regula Bullata
description: Franciscan rule approved by Pope Honorius in 1223.

name: Cum Delicti
description: Letter of approval from Pope Honorius commanding prelates to receive the Little Brothers as Catholic faithful.

name: Privilege of Poverty
description: 1228 privilege from Pope Gregory IX confirming the Poor Sisters' right to refuse endowments.

name: Rule of Clare
description: Rule devised by Clare, the first written by a woman, based on Francis' ideas and not requiring total enclosure.

name: Benedictine Rule
description: Conventional monastic rule on which Ugolino based a document for the Poor Sisters.

name: Minister General
description: Title of the leader of the Franciscans after Francis.

name: Monastic Enclosure
description: Rule of enclosure and stability of abode that Francis' preachers ignore.

name: Mass
description: Sacrament celebrated by ordained priests; a friar celebrating daily can change a Magical aura.

name: Sacraments
description: Church rites that friars may administer, causing conflicts with local clergy.

name: Heresy
description: Wrong doctrine; academic theologians and Franciscans risk accusation of it.

name: Aura
description: Supernatural aura of a place; a Magical aura can change under a friar's worship, and a priest may bring a Dominion aura.

name: Dominion Aura
description: Divine aura that magi fear would rise at a covenant where a priest settles.

name: Vis
description: Magical resource; a covenant's vis source may be lost if an aura changes.

name: Hermetic Code
description: Law of the Order of Hermes; a magus displaying spells to mundanes appears to violate it.

name: Theurgy
description: Magic of working with spirits; magi interested in it may investigate Francis.

name: Planetary Magic
description: Mystery technique invoking planetary influences when enchanting devices.

name: Interplanetary Magic
description: Theurgic magic of celestial spirits from Realms of Power: Magic.

name: Necromancy
description: Magic of death spirits of interest to characters investigating Francis' 'sister Bodily Death'.

name: Initiation Total
description: Total used to succeed at a Mystery initiation, including Script Bonus.

name: Organization Lore: Franciscans
description: Knowledge of the Franciscan organization; required with Presence for Franciscan Initiation Scripts.

name: Divine
description: Realm of God; Francis' powers and the Holy Tradition derive from it.

name: Infernal
description: Realm of demons, ever alert to tempt and corrupt the Franciscans.

name: Faerie
description: Realm whose creatures might be drawn to Francis' parables.

name: Magic
description: Realm of magic; a Magical aura hosts a covenant's vis source.

name: Dominion
description: The Divine presence in human society, subject of Dominion Lore and Dominion auras.

name: Astra Planeta
description: Named Spirits of the planets, two of whom Francis may be in touch with.

name: Selene
description: Named Spirit of the Moon, ruling commoners and witchcraft, possibly Francis' 'sister'.

name: Helios
description: Named Spirit of the Sun ruling healing, possibly Francis' 'brother'.

name: Named Spirits
description: Class of powerful spirits such as the Astra Planeta.

name: Spirits of the Elements
description: Low-powered elemental spirits tied to Terram, Ignem, and Auram that Francis may call Earth, Fire, and Wind.

name: Primal Spirit
description: Spirit governing the whole earth, possibly identified with Mother Earth by some.

name: Leti
description: Spirits of death, one of which Francis might call his sister Bodily Death.

name: Thanatoi
description: Leti spirits of peaceful death.

name: Keres
description: Leti spirits of violent death.

name: Moroi
description: Leti spirits of disease.

name: Angel
description: Divine messenger; one brought bread to Alemquer friary and angelic advice guides Francis' Initiation Scripts.

name: Demon
description: Infernal spirit; one possessed a madman, and demons tempt the friars.

name: Dragon of Assisi
description: Dragon seen prowling Assisi's walls in Sylvester's dream, put to flight by a cross from Francis' mouth.

name: San Damiano Crucifix
description: Byzantine-style crucifix in San Damian from which a voice told Francis to repair God's house.

name: Enchanted Brooch
description: Hermetic enchanted item lost by a Redcap that makes travel easier, found by a Franciscan friar.

name: Assisi
description: Italian town where Francis and Clare were born and the Franciscans are centered.

name: Perugia
description: Town at war with Assisi in 1202 where Francis was taken captive.

name: Church of San Damiano
description: Small semi-derelict church outside Assisi where Francis heard the crucifix speak; home of Clare's Poor Sisters.

name: Portiuncula
description: Site at Assisi of the Franciscans' first general chapter meeting.

name: Saint Mary of the Angels
description: Little chapel in Francis' valley near the original Franciscan settlement.

name: Francis' Cave
description: Cave high in a valley near Assisi where Francis meditated; site of Meditation and Purity Initiations.

name: Lateran Basilica
description: Basilica Innocent III dreamt of as collapsing but propped up by a small ragged man.

name: Rome
description: Seat of the papacy where Francis sought approval; Intervention Initiates travel there for a papal blessing.

name: Vatican
description: Papal residence where Francis requested an audience with Innocent III.

name: Bologna
description: City of the 1220 Dominican general meeting and where friars lived in a stone house planning a school.

name: Oxford
description: English city reached by the Preachers in 1221.

name: Holy Land
description: Region Francis tried to reach in 1212 and visited in 1219 with crusaders.

name: Syria
description: Where Francis met crusaders and Elias led the Friars Minor in 1219.

name: Dalmatian Coast
description: Coast where Francis' ship to the Holy Land was wrecked in 1212.

name: Morocco
description: Destination of early Franciscan missions where friars were martyred in 1220.

name: Belvilia
description: Place near Assisi where Elias Bonibarone was born.

name: Saint Paul's Nunnery
description: Benedictine nunnery near Bastia, Umbria, where Clare first took refuge.

name: Monticelli
description: Community near Florence founded by Agnes in 1219 and addressed by Ugolino's rule.

name: Vallegloria
description: Monastery at Spello in Umbria where Balvina became abbess.

name: Foligno
description: Town where Marsebilia and Cristiana founded a Poor Sisters group in 1217.

name: Arezzo
description: Site of the monastery Balvina left.

name: Alemquer
description: Friary where an angel brought bread to the brothers.

name: Constantinople
description: Seat of Jean de Brienne as emperor.

name: Provence
description: Region from which Francis' mother came.

name: Friar
description: Mendicant religious who travel preaching and begging.

name: Quaesitor
description: Hermetic investigator useful in the 'New Arrivals' story seed.

name: Archmage
description: Senior magus; one recruits characters to investigate Francis.

name: Elementalist
description: Hedge-magic practitioner who may wish to talk to Francis about elementals.

name: Franciscan Nun
description: Grog template for a Poor Sister with Lesser Purifying Touch.

name: Franciscan Friar
description: Grog template for a young mendicant friar.

name: Grog
description: Covenant servant; grog templates are provided for Franciscans.

name: Companion
description: Character type; a Franciscan teacher Companion appears in Realms of Power: The Divine.

name: Magus
description: Hermetic wizard, likely blamed for supernatural events.

name: Terram
description: Hermetic Form of earth, tied to Francis' spirit 'Earth'.

name: Ignem
description: Hermetic Form of fire, tied to Francis' spirit 'Fire'.

name: Auram
description: Hermetic Form of air, tied to Francis' spirit 'Wind'.

name: Mendicant Friar
description: Virtue covering male Franciscan characters; conventionally requires Monastic Vows.

name: True Faith
description: Virtue granting Faith Score and Faith Points; Francis has Faith Score 5.

name: Animal Ken
description: Virtue possessed by Francis and the Franciscan Friar template.

name: Great Presence
description: Virtue possessed by Francis.

name: Inspirational
description: Virtue possessed by Francis and Clare.

name: Premonitions
description: Virtue representing Devotion obtained with True Faith 2.

name: Educated
description: Virtue required of members of the Order of Preachers.

name: Magister in Artibus
description: Virtue/degree; Dominicans lacking it are sent to university.

name: Strong-Willed
description: Virtue possessed by Brother Elias.

name: Enduring Constitution
description: Virtue possessed by Brother Elias.

name: Senior Clergy
description: Social Status Virtue of Clare as abbess.

name: Intuition
description: Virtue possessed by Clare.

name: Privileged Upbringing
description: Virtue possessed by Clare.

name: Religious
description: Social Status appropriate to female Franciscans.

name: Improved Characteristics
description: Virtue of the Franciscan Nun template.

name: Lesser Purifying Touch
description: Virtue of the Franciscan Nun template, against Quotidian Fever.

name: Well-Traveled
description: Virtue of the Franciscan Friar template.

name: Second Sight
description: Virtue Francis may have if he communicates with spirits.

name: Gentle Gift
description: Virtue sparing a magus from blame in a story seed.

name: Meditation
description: Major Supernatural Virtue and Ability favored by the Franciscan Holy Tradition, gained by a season in Francis' cave.

name: Understanding
description: Major Supernatural Virtue and Ability gained by a vision before a Byzantine crucifix at Saint Damien.

name: Intervention
description: Major Supernatural Virtue and Ability gained by imitating Francis' winter journey and obtaining a papal blessing.

name: Purity
description: Major Supernatural Virtue and Ability gained through a season of fasting in Francis' cave.

name: Driven
description: Flaw; Francis is driven to live like the apostles, and Meditation initiates gain it as a Major Flaw.

name: Monastic Vows
description: Flaw compulsory for the Franciscan Holy Tradition.

name: Ability Block
description: Flaw blocking a category of Abilities.

name: Compassionate
description: Flaw possessed by Francis and Clare.

name: Fragile Constitution
description: Flaw from Divine Warping in Francis; gained with Purity initiation.

name: Social Handicap
description: Flaw; Francis has it for Unworldliness.

name: Small Frame
description: Flaw possessed by Clare.

name: Motion Sickness
description: Flaw possessed by Clare.

name: Weakness
description: Flaw of the Franciscan Nun template (babies).

name: Continence
description: Flaw of the Franciscan Nun template.

name: Lame
description: Flaw of the Franciscan Nun template.

name: Pious
description: Flaw of the Franciscan Friar template.

name: Temperate
description: Flaw of the Franciscan Friar template.

name: Visions
description: Minor Flaw gained with the Understanding initiation.

name: Plagued by Supernatural Entity
description: Flaw gained by an unworthy candidate attempting the Understanding initiation.

name: Magical Air
description: Flaw making a character stand out and be blamed for supernatural events.

name: Profession: Preacher
description: Ability describing a preacher's development; can always be learned by listening to a preacher.

name: Theology
description: Academic Ability; unwise to preach without a bishop's license.

name: Dominion Lore
description: Ability that preachers may teach.

name: Church Lore
description: Ability of knowledge about the Church.

name: Infernal Lore
description: Ability a peasant might learn from a preacher's admonitions.

name: Artes Liberales
description: Academic Ability taught by a friar to a spring covenant's grogs.

name: Civil and Canon Law
description: Ability possessed by Brother Elias.

name: Chirurgy
description: Ability of wound treatment.

name: Folk Ken
description: Ability of understanding people.

name: Leadership
description: Ability used by Francis, Elias, and Clare.

name: Concentration
description: Ability used in praying and preaching.

name: Area Lore
description: Ability of knowledge of a region.

name: Animal Handling
description: Ability; Francis specializes in birds.

name: Teaching
description: Ability used by Francis and Clare.

name: Philosophiae
description: Academic Ability possessed by Elias.

name: Etiquette
description: Ability possessed by Elias and Clare.

name: Awareness
description: Ability possessed by Francis and Clare.

name: Charm
description: Ability; Francis uses it in preaching.

name: Latin
description: Language Ability.

name: Italian
description: Language Ability.

name: Arabic
description: Language Ability possessed by Elias.
